title: Campesino-aligned road blockades protesting extended judicial appointments and disqualification of Morales
location_text: Road links from Cochabamba toward Santa Cruz, La Paz, Oruro and Chuquisaca; source reports activity in at least five departments but does not enumerate all sites.
organizers: Campesino organizations aligned with Evo Morales (source description)

physical_action.note: Road blockades described; bus service interruption is separate service impact, not attendance evidence.

start_date.note: Report explicitly says blockades began Monday 22 January.

target_and_demand.note: Protest against extended Constitutional Court justices and rulings disqualifying Morales from the 2025 race.

participants.note: No participant count or threshold evidence; do not infer from number of blocked roads/departments.

state_response.note: Only a prior police warning/forecast was reported; no actual response established.

end_date.note: Episode end not established by this source.

open_questions: Did any contemporaneous source document at least 50 participants in a single qualifying public gathering?
What was the exact physical event end date and did the blockade episode continue into February?
What actual state responses occurred during the blockades?
Can additional locally sourced reporting independently establish organizers, locations, attendance, and the episode timeline?
